plan.title: Participation count updates after vendor bid

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Assert the buyer initially sees no responses and a 0/2 participation counter.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal for Vendor A's bid.
Open the event's RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Submit Vendor A's quote using the vendor-side bid sheet.
Return to the buyer's event page to inspect the participation counter.
Assert that the buyer now sees one direct vendor response and participation has changed to 1/2.
